subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For replay-unsafe `stopReason=stop`, `tools>0`, `payloads=0` embedded turns, should OpenClaw add a safe retry/fallback path, persist a quarantine/repair record, or continue fail-closed with stronger diagnostics?
rationale: The current behavior is intentionally fail-closed for side-effect safety, but field evidence shows recurring user-visible failures; changing it requires deciding the product safety boundary for replay-unsafe tool turns.

options.title: Current-Attempt Safety Plus Quarantine
options.body: Separate current-attempt side effects from accumulated replay state, retry/fallback only when the current attempt is proven safe, and persist quarantine/repair evidence for unsafe malformed attempts.

options.title: Treat As Canonical Retry Policy Work
options.body: Route this entirely through the older replay-unsafe incomplete-turn policy issue and close or merge this only after that canonical policy covers quarantine/session-state concerns.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed Diagnostics Only
options.body: Preserve the no-retry behavior for all replay-unsafe tool turns and improve logs/diagnostics so operators can detect and recover manually.

recommendation.title: Current-Attempt Safety Plus Quarantine
recommendation.body: Separate current-attempt side effects from accumulated replay state, retry/fallback only when the current attempt is proven safe, and persist quarantine/repair evidence for unsafe malformed attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged reliability work and adjacent owner-boundary decisions make steipete the best available routing owner from the history sample.
